hooks.text: 双方为飞船累积能量并进行正面对冲，以冲击波胜负取代偷袭
hooks.excerpt: Both sides accumulate Power for their own spaceship and compete in a fair shockwave battle to determine who the winner is! This is the recognized way of battle in the LONESTAR Universe, without any surprise attacks!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 不同飞船各有专长和近百种专属单位，更多单位需要在旅途中逐步获得
hooks.excerpt: Each spaceship has its own expertise and possesses nearly a hundred exclusive units! (Note: The Association only provides initial units; other units need to be obtained by hunters during their journey.)
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 完成悬赏后进入带薪休假事件，在选择中获取下一段航程所需资源
hooks.excerpt: Every time you complete a Bounty Mission, the Association will offer a period of paid leave. During your vacation, you will encounter various unique events, make choices, and obtain resources.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
